title: Introduction to the Cash Basis IPSAS
nativeTitle: Introduction to the Cash Basis IPSAS
summary: Provides the background, purpose, jurisdictional autonomy principles, and binary compliance threshold for the Cash Basis IPSAS, framing it as an interim stepping stone toward accrual adoption.
description: The Introduction to the Cash Basis IPSAS serves as a preamble to the 2017 revised Standard. It explains why a cash-basis standard exists alongside accrual IPSAS, respects the sovereignty of national standard-setters, reinforces that compliance requires satisfying all of Part 1, and encourages governments to use the standard as a path toward accrual-basis IPSAS and Study 14 transition guidance.
